7.description: [Pending Restart] Titanic Fury from Fury of the Titans now lasts 12 sec, changed from 10. Now increases damage versus players by 20%, changed from 10%. (It can be difficult to trigger in PvP so you should be rewarded when it does.)
[Pending Restart] Fixed a recent bug where the Chain Lightning damage reduction from Lightning Strikes Twice did not apply versus players.
[Pending Restart] Dragon Charge now has a 30 sec cooldown, changed from 35. (Now has the same cooldown as Intercept.)
Crush from Heavyweight now deals 50% less damage versus players, changed from 75%.

5.description: [Pending Restart] Polearms from TBC Honor and Arena point vendors now have a 3.6 weapon speed, changed from 2.2. (You might need to delete your cache to see this change.)

[Classic HR Enchants and Recipes] will become soulbound, meaning they will no longer be tradable or able to be placed on the AH following the next server restart. These items are not usable in TBC content.

1.description: [Pending Restart] Charge can now be recasted for up to 5 sec, changed from 3 sec.
[Pending Restart] Spirit Bond now also works on summoned Warlock pets. (This means it now works with all pets.)
[Pending Restart] Elusiveness now reduces the cooldown of Blind by 15/30 sec, changed from 30/60 sec.
Envenom now deals 10% reduced damage versus players, changed from 25%.
[Area 52] Corruption now deals 35% reduced damage versus players, changed from 40%.
[Area 52] Shadow Word: Pain now deals 40% reduced damage versus players, changed from 35%.
[Area 52] Smite now deals 10% reduced damage versus players. It previously had no modifier.
[Area 52] Frost Bomb now deals 25% reduced damage versus players, changed from 20%.
[Area 52] Frostbolt now deals 20% reduced damage versus players, changed from 15%.

2.description: [Al'ar] [High-Risk] Disabled Classic Hidden Cache and Beast Nest quests that were incorrectly available. Improved Hidden Caches and Beast Nests will be enabled in Outlands as we continue to rollout the TBC High-Risk Overhaul.

[Al'ar] [High-Risk] Fixed an issue where High-Risk Dailies were not correctly resetting with the Daily Quest reset. As a temporary solution to the problem Outlaws will be able to accept Tier 1 and Tier 2 daily quests.

[Al'ar] [High-Risk] Fixed a bug where Heroic Bloodforged items could drop while in a raid group. The intended functionality is that HR Events do not grant their bonus drops to raid groups to promote more fair fights and allow for balanced shared party loot for players grouping with other loyal members of their faction.

0.description: [Al'ar] [High-Risk Crafting] Players that are level 70 and have 375/375 in their profession can now properly train consumable and item enchants requiring Rare Tier 1 Resources.

[Al'ar] [High-Risk Crafting] Players that are level 70 and have 375/375 in their profession can now properly train High-Risk Resource Transmute spells from Outlands Profession trainers and the Book of Ascension. These Transmute spells allow you to transmute Rare Resources into Epic Resources for Lesser Profane Nether once per week.

[Al'ar] [High-Risk Crafting] Players that are level 70 and have 375/375 in their profession can now properly train High-Risk Resource Refinement spells from Outlands Profession trainers and the Book of Ascension.
[Al'ar] [High-Risk Crafting] Fixed an issue where some Tier 1 High-Risk recipes were not on trainers.
[Al'ar] [High-Risk Crafting] Fixed an issue where trainers were missing their High-Risk Refinement spells.
[Al'ar] [High-Risk Crafting] Fixed an issue where some trainers were offering recipes from other professions.
[Requires Launcher Update] Updated the data for the Loss of Control popup
[Requires Launcher Update] Added a check box to make suggested talents include your equipped legendary mystic enchant in its calculation.

8.description: [Alar] [Area-52] [TBC] - Weekly Timewalking Dungeon Quests now reward 1250 Marks up from 250. This quest also rewards 5 Badges of Justice.
[Alar] [Area-52] [TBC] - Weekly Timewalking Raid Quests now reward 1500 Marks up from 500. This amount is slightly lower than the Heroes Call quest as this quest also rewards 10 Badges of Justice.
[Alar] [Area-52] [TBC] - Weekly Heroes Call quests will now reward 2250 Marks of Ascension up from 500. This matches the amount of Marks of Ascension you can receive from the City Siege quest.

Keeper Scroll: High-Risk Events (Repeatable) now requires 4 Lesser Profane Essence instead of 8. You can currently earn 6 Lesser Profane Essence from HR Daily Quests per day. Accept any Tier quest to have 6 additional quests of that Tier made available to you.
Fixed an issue where some High-Risk Population Control quests were not correctly granting kill credit. (Pending Restart).

6.description: [Alar] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Prince Malchezarr] Pending Restart - Corrected an issue where Prince Malchezaars Doom casts would create an exorbitant amount of lag. Prince Malchezaars Doom ability now inflicts four times less instances of damage and every instance now inflicts four times more damage.

[Alar] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Shade of Aran] Pending Restart - The Arcane Explosions during Shade of Arans final phase no longer include players active absorption effects to calculate their damage dealt. Arcane Explosions still inflict damage equal to 48% of a players maximum health but this damage can now be fully negated by absorption effects.

[Alar] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Shade of Aran] Pending Restart - Arcane Explosion Spiral now occurs exactly every 15 Seconds on all difficulties. Previously occurred every 10 Seconds on Ascended and 20 Seconds on Heroic and Normal difficulty, delayed by a random amount of time depending on Shade of Arans currently casted spell after his cowering phase ended.
[Alar] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Shade of Aran] Pending Restart - Corrected an issue where Shade of Aran would Occasionally interrupt his spells with his Chains of Ice ability.
